methodology: Rolling 7/30-day windows ending at the observation time, using default-branch committer timestamps. Contributors are linked GitHub author accounts, including bots and excluding unlinked authors. Public releases use published_at and include prereleases. Code quality, originality, actual work time and token association are not verified.

comparison.note: Baseline from imported JSON: unverified and editable, not an official or signed certificate. Newly observed SHA values do not prove new work. Rolling windows, history changes, delayed updates and collection limits affect differences. Missing observations do not prove deletion or manipulation.
